mapper.sql: id, instance_id, variable_id, variable_value, calculated_value, is_calculated, calculation_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.instance_id, v.variable_id, v.variable_value, v.calculated_value, v.is_calculated, v.calculation_error, v.created_at, v.updated_at, mv.variable_code, mv.variable_name, mv.variable_type, mv.data_type, mv.unit, mv.is_required, mv.display_order, mv.description FROM soo_model_instance_variable v LEFT JOIN soo_model_variable mv ON v.variable_id = mv.id WHERE v.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY mv.display_order ASC, mv.variable_name ASC

SELECT v.id, v.instance_id, v.variable_id, v.variable_value, v.calculated_value, v.is_calculated, v.calculation_error, v.created_at, v.updated_at, mv.variable_code, mv.variable_name, mv.variable_type, mv.data_type, mv.unit, mv.is_required, mv.display_order, mv.description FROM soo_model_instance_variable v LEFT JOIN soo_model_variable mv ON v.variable_id = mv.id WHERE v.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND v.variable_id = #{variableId}

update.foreach: UPDATE soo_model_instance_variable SET variable_value = #{variable.variableValue}, calculated_value = #{variable.calculatedValue}, is_calculated = #{variable.isCalculated}, calculation_error = #{variable.calculationError}, updated_at = #{variable.updatedAt} WHERE instance_id = #{variable.instanceId} AND variable_id = #{variable.variableId}

mapper.update: UPDATE soo_model_instance_variable SET calculated_value = #{calculatedValue}, is_calculated = #{isCalculated}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND variable_id = #{variableId}
